text:
marie: Heads up — new quantized onboarding run (q-onboard-v2 int4) has elevated hallucination on long docs. Thinking we should refresh a small golden and run a labeler surge. Thoughts?
ryan: ugh. can you paste an example? link?
marie: here's a failing example: 'response invents policy that doesn't exist' — happened on ~7/200 long-form samples on canary.
anya: ok. we should triage: 1) reproduce on baseline fp16, 2) collect 2k long docs filtered by >1k tokens, 3) dedupe fuzzy then label. agree? :+1:
sam: agree. recommend dedupe threshold 0.85 and keep holdout 10% for eval bench.
marie: sounds good. jen — can label_ops run an on-demand batch for ~2k items and prioritize hallucination categories? cc @label_ops_bot
label_ops_bot: label_ops received. ETA 48h for 2k prioritised items at current capacity (working hours only). queue id: LQ-9912
jen: we can boot a small surge — will need +3 annotators for 2 days. need signoff from ops for contractor spend.
ryan: also run an fp16 vs int4 token-level diff; if quality gap > 3pt BERT-F1 on golden then halt rollout. we'll add regression alert in eval harness.
sam: sampling SQL for the seed (feel free to tweak):
```sql
SELECT id, text
FROM corpus
WHERE char_length(text) > 1000
AND NOT text ~ '\/redacted\/'
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 2000;
```
anya: i'll run fuzzyhash dedupe afterwards. command:
```bash
python tools/fuzzy_dedupe.py --input seed.csv --threshold 0.85 --output seed.dedupe.csv
```
jen: labeling schema: hallucination, hallucination_severity (low/med/high), hallucination_type (fabrication/incorrect_fact/unsupported), context_trail
marie: ok team — decision: proceed with 2k seed, dedupe 0.85, 10% holdout, labeler surge, run fp16 baseline compare. i'll open a tracking ticket and update the canary plan. thanks :saved:
ryan: ping when ticket is up and when LQ-9912 starts. I'll wire the eval alerts.
label_ops_bot: LQ-9912 started. assigned: jen, leah, owen. progress: 0/2000
